display.purpose: Page titles and strong entry points only.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle elevation for interactive cards on hover.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Soft separation for dialogs, popovers, and floating panels.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Short transitions for hover, focus, and disclosure states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact violet action for the primary task on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9929EA; color: #fff; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7D1FC2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9929EA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action for toolbars and contextual controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #64748B; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F8FAFC; color: #172033; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9929EA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Neutral field with a clear focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #172033; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #DBE3EC; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #C6D2DF; outline: 2px solid rgba(153, 41, 234, 0.22); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat operational surface with restrained interactive lift.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #172033; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #DBE3EC; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #C6D2DF; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact state indicator used only when the state carries meaning.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #F8FAFC; color: #64748B; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 10px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Scannable navigation row with quiet hover and clear active contrast.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #64748B; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 13px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F8FAFC; color: #172033; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #F5E7FF; color: #5B148F; }

components.css: .ds-node-search { width: 240px; max-width: calc(100vw - 24px); overflow: hidden; background: #fff; color: #172033; border: 1px solid #DBE3EC; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-node-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-node-search-input { width: 100%; height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #DBE3EC; outline: none; color: #172033; font: 400 .6875rem/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-node-search-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #9929EA; } .ds-node-search-results { max-height: 176px; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: auto; list-style: none; } .ds-node-search-result { display: flex; min-height: 26px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: .6875rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-node-search-result[aria-selected=true], .ds-node-search-result:hover { background: #F5E7FF; color: #5B148F; } .ds-node-search-result small { color: #64748B; font-size: .6875rem; line-height: 12px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-node-search-input { height: 44px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-node-search-result { min-height: 44px; font-size: 12px; } }

narrative.overview: SimFlow is an operational workflow tool, so the interface should feel calm, dense, and dependable during repeated daily use. Visual hierarchy comes from typography, proximity, alignment, and restrained contrast rather than decoration. The primary accent is reserved for actions, active states, focus, and selected surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with structural borders and selective elevation.
One recognizable violet accent used sparingly and consistently.
Responsive layouts that use available space without page-level overflow.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is an interaction signal, not a decorative fill.

rules.name: The No-Display-Costume Rule
rules.body: Do not use gradient text, oversized headings, all-caps decoration, or monospace text unless the content is genuinely code or measurement data.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface should earn elevation through interaction or overlay behavior.

dos: Do use Plus Jakarta Sans Variable throughout the application UI.
Do use spacing, typography, alignment, and contrast to establish hierarchy.
Do keep responsive overflow local to the region that needs it.
donts: Don't use large decorative gradients, glassmorphism, glow, or heavy shadowed cards.
Don't turn every element into a pill, card, badge, or nested surface.
Don't create page-level horizontal scrolling to solve a local layout problem.
